# PDFperch
> Free, private, client-side PDF tools. All processing runs in the browser — no file uploads, no account required.

## About
PDFperch is a browser-based productivity suite offering 21 free PDF and document tools. Files never leave the user's device.

## Core Tools
- [Merge PDF](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/mergepdf.html): Combine multiple PDFs into one file
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/compresspdf.html): Reduce PDF file size by up to 70%
- [Split PDF](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/splitpdf.html): Extract pages from a PDF
- [Rotate PDF](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/rotatepdf.html): Rotate pages 90°, 180°, 270°
- [PDF to JPG](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/pdf2jpg.html): Convert PDF pages to images
- [JPG to PDF](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/img2pdf.html): Convert images to PDF
- [Word to PDF](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/docx2pdf.html): Convert DOCX to PDF
- [PDF to Word](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/pdf2word.html): Convert PDF to editable DOCX
- [PowerPoint to PDF](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/pptx2pdf.html): Convert PPTX slides to PDF
- [Sign PDF](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/signpdf.html): Add a visual signature (typed, drawn, or uploaded image) to a PDF
- [Encrypt PDF](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/pdfencrypt.html): Password-protect a PDF
- [Watermark PDF](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/watermarkpdf.html): Add text watermark to PDF
- [Add Page Numbers](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/pagenumbers.html): Stamp page numbers on PDF
- [Organize PDF](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/organizepdf.html): Reorder PDF pages
- [OCR](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/ocrtool.html): Extract text from scanned images
- [Markdown to PDF](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/md2pdf.html): Convert .md files to PDF
- [HTML to PDF](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/web2pdf.html): Convert web pages to PDF
- [Compress Images](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/imgcompress.html): Reduce image file size
- [Image Converter](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/img2png.html): Convert between image formats
- [QR Code Generator](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/qrmaker.html): Create custom QR codes
- [TXT to Word](https://pdfperch-7xd.pages.dev/pages/txt2docx.html): Convert plain text to DOCX

## Key Differentiator
Everything runs in the browser using WebAssembly. No files are uploaded to servers.
